products.body_html:
CENTURY 850 Gold

Fully Modular Gold Certified Power Supply

  • 80 plus Gold certified, with 91% efficiency or higher under typical loads
  • Fully modular to reduce clutter and improve airflow
  • 100% high quality Japanese 105°C/221°F capacitors, full-bridge LLC resonant converter and DC-DC technology
  • Fluid Dynamic Bearing premium fan enhanced quiet operation and increased lifespan
  • Heavy-duty protections, including OCP, OVP, UVP, OPP, SCP, and OTP

POWER UP WITHOUT ANY NOISE

The Century series brings a premium power supply unit in 550, 650, 850 wattage. It offers 80 Plus Gold efficiency rating, full modular cables, premium FDB fan, 100% Japanese high-quality capacitors.

And it features superior full bridge LLC resonant converter together with DC-DC circuitry, put this product on the mountain top for gold power supply.

HIGH EFFICIENCY AND LOWER OPERATING COSTS

Century series is certified 80 PLUS® Gold, it can effectively save energy consumption and guaranties a minimum of 90 % efficiency at 50% load, producing less heat generation. Also, the series has been optimized with all generations of Intel's processors to maximize energy saving.

MODERN CIRCUIT LAYOUT DELIVERS SUPERIOR PERFORMANCE

Century series uses a full bridge LLC resonant converter framework together with DC-DC circuity, plus 100% Japanese capacitors and all high- quality components. Making the Century Series power supply reliable for safety and stable voltage outputs, better performance and higher efficiency.

DURABLE AND SECURE - High Quality Components

Century series adopts 100% Japanese industrial level electronic capacitors for high durability, also achieve tight voltage and low ripple noise to enhance performance.
Moreover, it’s durable in high temperature and high pressure, therefore can effectively increase the lifespan of computer components.

SILENT OPERATION AND LONGER LIFESPAN

The advantage of using Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) in the fan is to enhance the impact absorbance effects of oil. It generates less noise and heat than most of the other bearing. And, it can effectively reduce friction and vibration due to the lubrication of the bearing surface. Therefore, more reliable performance and considerably longer lifespan.

USER FRIENDLY CABLING

Fully modular cable set allows users to only attach the cables they need, reducing cable clutter and increasing airflow.

5 YEAR WARRANTY

The century series offers 5 year warranty. This shows our confidence and the quality of this power supply.

The Seasonic PRIME PX-2200 is a robust power supply capable of safely powering up to four RTX 4090 graphics cards, thanks to its adherence to ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 specifications. Designed for demanding applications such as artificial intelligence and other high-power workloads, this flagship unit from the PRIME series delivers top-tier performance built on high-quality components.

ATX 3.1 and 16-Pin PCIe Gen 5.1 Cable (12V-2x6)

Seasonic’s latest PRIME ATX 3.1 Series is designed and built to power new PC components requiring the new ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.1 standards.

Micro Tolerance Load Regulation

Seasonic’s latest design keeps the output voltage within a very tight range, achieving under 1 % load regulation. This impressive electrical performance and stability makes this power supply an ideal choice for high-performance systems.

Digital Hybrid Fan Control

Seasonic’s vast experience in designing the most silent and efficient power supplies on the market was translated into the development of Hybrid Mode; a state-of-the-art digital fan control that enables users to keep the overall fan noise at the lowest possible level.

  • Reduced noise without increase in temperature
  • Extended fan life due to the reduced number of fan rotations
  • Optimized heat dissipation at all times
  • Unsurpassed silent performance in Fanless Mode

Fluid Dynamic Fan Bearing

High performance Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fans are designed to take advantage of the impact absorbance effects of oil. They are extremely reliable and generate considerably less operating noise and heat than ball bearing fans. The lubrication of the bearing surface reduces friction and vibration and therefore lowers overall power consumption. Due to the effortless, quieter rotations and its robust construction, this reliable fan technology also greatly increases the lifespan of the fan.
